study: Dual-source conditional means and cross-fitted feedback transfer
scope: New preregistered development experiment on previously exposed cached RNA data. Prior v2 results and user supplied post-hoc diagnostics known; not independent confirmation.

stages.P0: Source provenance and A/B transfer identifiability audit, no causal variance decomposition without repeats.
stages.P1: Matched-information one-A comparison, dual conditional means and refitted residual transfer.
stages.P2: Full0-to8 adaptive/LLM acquisition remains gated by the P1 transfer screen. A supplementary training-alpha-zero pre-buy stop is evaluated now as a limited deterministic contract.
stages.P3_P4: Untouched qualified measurement units and functional cost evidence required before production.

data.histories: Original v2 SeedSequence([seed,held]) nested disjoint histories; whole-context3 inner folds by sorted position modulo3.
data.reference: All45 public basal rows only. Freeze per-gene mean/RMSscale, positive median pairwise squared standardized distance. Transductive target-state access is allowed and disclosed; no target outcome or independent reference claim.
data.endpoint: Original signed39geneRNA, not functional viability/apoptosis/protein engagement. Original A/B partitions are not independent cultures; STATE pretraining overlap and all outcomes previously exposed.

means.STATE: Frozen cache and M2 history-weighted B mean+.5targetSTATEdeviation unchanged.
means.A_baseline: M2 B mean plus historical A-B mean offset.
means.conditional: Independent fixed-lambda10 tensor-product ridge adapters for A and B; public-reference RBFcell kernel times exact-dose/unit drugGram. MAP/molecule/Morgan/identity-permuted knowledge have identical fixed capacity.
means.singleton: Baseline means only, exactly zero adapter, no pseudo labels.
means.OOF: Each historical residual k uses complete conditional mean fit excluding k; its adapter baseline residual bank j excludes both k and j. Fixed penalty prevents own-label hyperparameter leakage. No residual-bank or model tuning on held outer labels.

support.continuous: n_eff=sum(w)^2/sum(w^2); support=n_eff/(n_eff+4); distance_ratio=nearest_target_history_distance_squared/reference_bandwidth_squared; distance_factor=1/(1+distance_ratio). No small-fold hard threshold.
support.interpretation: Heuristic distribution support, not demonstrated transfer reliability or risk certificate.

covariance.old: Baseline LOO A/B residual second moments. Dual-corrected conditional A/B means still used for the old-covariance arm; isolates bank choice.
covariance.refit: True-OOF dual-mean residual second moments, not unrestricted new covariance fit. Half diagonal shrink, exact-dose/unit Schurmask and tiny1e-12 numerical ridge. Representation matrices use the same existing PSDkernel/rho construction.
covariance.noise: Observed residual second moments already include variation; do not add publicobsvar or treat precision as independently measured noise.
covariance.update: B mean+=effectivealpha*c/vA*(yA-muA_corrected); covarianceBB-=effectivealpha*ccT/vA. effectivealpha=trainingselectedalpha*continuous_support*distancefactor*min(1,3/absinnovationz). This observation-dependent covariance is a diagnostic surrogate, not exact Gaussian posterior.

decision.pairs: Same pre-A M2ranks3-5 crossed6-8, nine frozen pairs.
decision.query: Same M2boundary midpoint rank5/6 candidate, index ties. All primary feedback arms purchase the same one A.
decision.selection: Full146-menu top5 by coherent candidate scores.
decision.tuning: Inner whole-background mean Top5 B regret, alpha grid[0,.01,.1,.25], representationcoveta grid[0,.5]. Tie alpha0 theneta0. Fixed mean penalty10 for all representations.
decision.probabilities: InnerOOF RMS standardized pair error inflation at least1; exact ties undefined Brier handled with counts. Diagnostics only.
decision.prices: Each no-feedback policy cost5B; primary feedback cost1A+5B=6 even when alpha0, commoncap6. No currency or NetVOI. Supplementary prebuy stop skipsA when trainingalpha0, cost5, preserves same conditionalmean. Otherwise cost6 and sameupdate.
decision.release: A source service returns only chargedquery; all policyrequests persisted before release. Target B evaluator-only after commitmentfreeze.

analysis.primary: Full-menu Top5 B utility increment, and equivalent Top5 regret reduction.
analysis.mechanism: Frozen-pair regret and corrected/harmful flips relative M2 AND the same mean-only adapter. Feedback-specific relativeknowledge_mean risk/coverage gates prevent mean-only effects being misattributed.
analysis.diagnostics: OOFA/BMSE, covariance rho, transfer coefficient direction stability, effectiveupdates/support/eta, rawA/Bcorrelation and ambiguityband. No causal source/noise separation without independently known repeats.
analysis.units: Average3seed results inside each of43 backgrounds. Pair/seeds/queries do not increase biological independent denominator. Nominal95%t intervals; exposed data and overlappingtrain histories limit inference.
analysis.multiplicity: Holm independently inside3primarytransfer Top5 comparisons and5knowledgeattribution Top5 comparisons; allreported.
analysis.transfer_gate: n8 knowledge_refit_map haspositiveTop5increment andHolmp<=.05 againstall3transfercomparators; frozen-pair regretimprovementvsM2>=.001RNA(original meaningfulscreen retained); feedback-specificharmful/totalflip<=.10 andcoverage>=.05; Brier<=knowledge_mean+.01. Zero updates/flips fail coverage.
analysis.knowledge_gate: Transfergate pluspositiveTop5gain/Holmp<=.05 againstall5attributioncontrols andatleastoneeffectiveeta>0 episode. An eta0 gain cannot support knowledgecovariance-specific claim.
analysis.P2_release: Only transfergate passes enables broader0/1/2/4/8 acquisition/LLM factorial. Failures retain P0/P1result and use next alternatives; do not outcome-retune currentfreeze.
analysis.promotion: No src/tools promotion from exposed development even if gates pass.

execution.pilot: Firstcompletecontext only, nine episodes, ten arms; frozen before run. Gate is engineeringintegrity only (finite outputs, correctphases, counts); no scientificparameter decisions based on pilot outcomes. Then samefrozen full43context run.
execution.freeze: Finalprotocol/source/tests/publicreference/input hashes before new P1fitting. Independent verifier self-freezes before score inspection. Separateimmutable prepare/commit/evaluate.
execution.reproduce: Original v2 freeze and artifacts unchanged. Fullportablecachedreplay after independent reconstruction, sameWindowsdependencies. Rawcheckpoint/gene-axis missing remainsblocked.
